notes: Interactive Swiss lever escapement watch movement explainer with physically accurate simulation. Features: single source of truth (simulation time), play/pause/step/scrub timeline with phase markers, live readouts (amplitude, rate error, beat error, torque, mainspring turns, power reserve), component inspection with hover/click selection and detailed specs, real-time graphs of torque/amplitude/beat-error/rate-error, what-if mode with adjustable parameters (mainspring torque, balance inertia, hairspring stiffness, pallet lubrication, banking clearance, amplitude target) and failure modes (broken mainspring, stuck hairspring, chipped pallet stone, bent escape tooth, bent banking pin, failed lubrication, shock damage). Technical illustration with cutaway view showing all 11 components (mainspring, barrel, center wheel, third wheel, fourth wheel, escape wheel, pallet fork, balance wheel, hairspring, roller jewel, shock protection) with materials, gear ratios, and jewel counts. Keyboard shortcuts for all controls. WCAG AA contrast, reduced motion support, responsive down to mobile.
